name: Morita Holdings Corporation
summary: Morita Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of ladder trucks, fire trucks, and specialty vehicles in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Fire truck, disaster prevention, Industrial machinery, and Eco-friendly vehicles. It offers fire trucks, including ladder trucks, aerial platforms, chemical/water tenders, rescue truck, aircraft rescue and fire fighting vehicles, multi-purpose fire fighting vehicles, CAFS/water pumps, and maintenance.
